evidence_status: POSTHOC shared environment compatibility supplement. Weaker evidence status than primary blind experiment; primary failed Android-U evaluation remains immutable and must be reported alongside. Not treatment benefit.

defect_clusters.description: A successful same-process caller replacement changes context to Study room but focuses Botanical folio and reinstates the initial decisions instead of the replacement seed (Harbor sketch focus, bowl care/structure, sketch pending). P1 shows 1 reviewed/0 follow-ups rather than 2/1; P2 shows 3 reviewed/0 rather than 2/1 and incorrectly enables submission. These are related manifestations of one replacement-state failure. Source has request-id onChange reset logic, but runtime evidence proves that its resulting state is wrong; the precise closure/framework mechanism is not asserted.

The disabled primary in light mode and disabled read-only classification controls in dark mode receive a visible extra fade beyond the brief’s border fill and muted text roles. The primary appears much paler than the reference disabled primary; dark disabled labels and fills are substantially dimmer than the assigned roles. Source explicitly selects border/muted colors and then applies PlainButtonStyle with disabled, consistent with the observed additional framework treatment. This is an appearance defect, not a claim that unsupported native iOS color measurements became available.

Component root does not paint the required canvas role, so the actual Android host canvas #EDF1F6 (light) / #0D1420 (dark) shows through internal component regions instead of #FFFFFF / #1C1424. The requirement is explicit in the original brief/reference. Actual original images, rendered samples and production source lacking canvas fill establish the cause. Host outer padding/sentinel are excluded. One canvas defect manifests across states/cases, not independent bugs. Newly observed in this posthoc recheck; no self-review detection credit or introduction claim.

source-a.source_api_disposition: Both exact sealed platform sources expose required API and native builds/tests completed successfully. Structural API review is source-hash and original-build bound. Runtime replacement behavior is reported in the business cluster; no signature/compilation issue found.
source-a.symmetry: Identical review scope, fixed checks and visual criteria applied to each anonymous source.

unasserted_scope.requirement: Exact fonts, weights and colors for every non-title role, all surface/canvas/border/primary roles, corner radius10, inset12, major16 and stacked8 gaps.
unasserted_scope.gap: Selected ledger has exact native title style and selected control boxes only. A broad visual decision assesses hierarchy/readability/appearance but does not numerically prove every style or spacing detail.

unasserted_scope.requirement: Every queue row identity/label and active selected state, third-row navigation, long labels growing above64, and caption/name role styling.
unasserted_scope.gap: Ledger directly checks second-row selection/status and queue width, with other identities seen visually; it is not exhaustive row-by-row semantics or large caller-text stress validation.

unasserted_scope.requirement: Exact caller context, material, focused inspection-note content, Review notes identity and every supplied paragraph.
unasserted_scope.gap: Title and focused title have exact copy assertions; note wrapping has a selected native-style family, and broad visual review checks ordered paragraphs. There are no separate exact-copy/identifier cells for all other text nodes and notes.

unasserted_scope.requirement: Unknown focusID fallback; optional pending inclusion; care seed with absent/invalid reason; validation-priority combinations; care reselect retains reason; Stable clears prior reason; re-entering care clears a prior stable reason; switching Surface/Structure.
unasserted_scope.gap: These are brief requirements without separate selected22-family cells covering each transition/input combination in P1/P2. Do not infer comprehensive business coverage from the delivered actions.

unasserted_scope.requirement: Read-only care reason editing, every read-only navigation path, callbacks after replacement, sorted optional-pending payload, no nested native OnClick, and state persistence across all focus sequences.
unasserted_scope.gap: Selected ledger tests some current control/callback states and one replacement route; structural source review adds context but does not invent acceptance cells or successful dispatches.

unasserted_scope.requirement: No duplicate outer padding/nested vertical scrolling and all dedicated text/heading identities.
unasserted_scope.gap: Broad composition and structural review are relevant but fixed geometry cells measure only primary height, queue width and conditional care-control height. They do not independently quantify every host/component allocation.

source-a.previously_confirmed_ios_classification: All original iOS product F classifications/clusters retained unchanged, including category and row identities.

newly_observed_issues.scope: Posthoc-only Android visual canvas mismatch; no original own-review detection credit.

source-a.supplement_delta_policy: Newly unmasked Android rows and supplementary visual review do not imply newly introduced defects. Existing iOS product classification is unchanged.
